preconditions.description: The input parameter text must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output string has the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == text[i] for i in range(len(text)) if text[i] == ' ')
postconditions.description: All space characters in the input string are preserved at their exact original positions in the output string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == text[j] for i, j in zip(range(len(text)), range(len(text))) if text[i] != ' ' and text[j] != ' ' and (i < j or (i == j and text[i] == text[j])) and (lambda: (lambda start, end: (lambda word: word[::-1] == return_value[start:end])(text[start:end])))(lambda: (lambda k: (lambda s, e: (s, e))(0, 0))(0))())
postconditions.description: Every contiguous sequence of non-space characters (a word) in the input is reversed in the output, while maintaining the original sequence of words and spaces.
